scope: Independent adversarial verification of Todo 4 only; no product edits made.

blockers.finding: Unity request-70 response serializes runtime.ShotRecorder directly from live read-only views; there is no complete immutable recorder snapshot or finalized-shot validity gate before BuildCaptureEnvelope.
Unity-side direct socket path does not enforce MaxEnvelopeBytes or bounded PNG/state/event lengths; bounds exist only in the Python decoder and the Unity constant is unused by Serve.
Repository .gitignore does not cover common secret filenames/extensions; targeted changed-source scans were clean, but the repository-wide scanner timed out.

direct_tcp_topology.detail: Unity uses TcpListener(IPAddress.Loopback, port); Python uses AF_INET/SOCK_STREAM and connects to the same host/port. Legacy WebSocket path remains separate.

request_70_unused_elsewhere.detail: RequestCode assigns GET_PHYSICS_CAPTURE_V1=70; targeted protocol dispatch review found no conflicting request-code enum/case.

python_strict_protocol.detail: Python checks outer envelope bounds, magic, version, payload length, flags/failure code, failure message length/UTF-8, success record bounds, JSON types/constants, PNG signature, and render-frame equality; protocol errors disconnect.

immutable_parsed_data.detail: Parsed state is mappingproxy, nested lists are tuples, events are a tuple; mutation probe rejected mapping and tuple writes.

png_state_event_frame_equality.detail: Python decoder requires state render_frame and every event render_frame to match; Unity test and live fixture used matching frame 913/73.

wait_for_end_of_frame.detail: PhysicalSnapshotRuntime.CaptureAtEndOfRenderFrame yields WaitForEndOfFrame before CaptureCurrent; Unity focused test passed.

complete_bounded_recorder_snapshot.detail: No copied/finalized recorder snapshot is created before serialization; live recorder views are passed to BuildCaptureEnvelope.

legacy_request_38_62.detail: RequestCode preserves 38 and 62; rerun fixture preserved !B + five signed int32 request 38 and !B request 62 framing/fixture suffix.

enum_integrity.detail: GT_SHOOT=38 and GET_GROUND_TRUTH_WITHOUT_SCREENSHOT=62 remain present and distinct from 70.
